answers_changed.input: “The most unique aspect of all was how it was funded,” Kurşun added. Abdul Hamid contributed personally, and taxes were levied within the empire, complemented by voluntary donations from the global Muslim community. Donations arrived from across the Muslim world, including British India, Singapore and South Africa, turning the railway into a rare pan-Islamic infrastructure project that extended far beyond Ottoman territory itself. answers_changed.input: Ottoman authorities deployed thousands of mil- itary conscripts to build the railway, said Kurşun, and the landscapes in which they worked were fierce, varied and often far from urban centers. In his com- prehensive 2005 history book <style id='1'>The Hejaz Railway</style>, author James Nicholson writes, “Winding its way through some of the most dramatic desert mountain scenery in the world...its construction was a tale of endurance and resolve made epic by the heat {v3}and{v4}the harsh conditions.”

answers_changed.input: We were roughly 80 miles (129 km) south of Al- Ula in the west of Saudi Arabia. I traveled there in the spring of 2024 to research the Hijaz Railway, which, in the early years of the 20th century, ran for some 800 miles (1,287 km) from Damascus, Syria, to Madinah. On this day, looking at Hijaz, the rugged, mountainous region that extends in every direction, I found such a feat hard to imagine. Al Juhani, the head of his tribe in the area, had offered to show me what remained.
baseline: 我们大约在沙特阿拉伯西部的阿尔乌拉（Al-Ula）以南80英里（129公里）处。我于2024年春天前往那里，研究希贾兹铁路（HIJAZ RAILWAY），该铁路在20世纪初从叙利亚大马士革（Damascus）延伸至麦地那（Madinah），全长约800英里（1,287公里）。在这一天，看到希贾兹（Hijaz），这个向四面八方延伸的崎岖山地，我觉得这样的壮举难以想象。阿尔·朱哈尼（Al Juhani），该地区部落的首领，主动提出带我看看遗留的部分。

answers_changed.input: In December 2025, Saudi Arabia and Qatar signed an agreement for a high-speed electric railway linking Riyadh and Doha. In the spring of 2026, Türkiye and Saudi Arabia formally agreed to advance plans for a railway connecting the two countries through Jordan and Syria. More than a century later, some of the original ambitions behind the Hijaz Railway— including regional integration and the movement of people—are once again shaping infrastructure discussions across the region.
baseline: 2025年12月，沙特阿拉伯和卡塔尔签署了一项协议，计划建设一条连接利雅得和多哈的高速电气化铁路。到2026年春天，土耳其和沙特阿拉伯正式同意推进一项计划，通过约旦和叙利亚连接两国的铁路。一个多世纪后，希贾兹铁路背后的一些最初愿景——包括区域一体化和人员流动——再次在整个地区的基础设施讨论中发挥作用。

answers_changed.input: The optimism surrounding the railway did not last long. Less than a decade later, during World War I, the railway was repeatedly attacked. Raiding par- ties destroyed large sections of the route—including the stretch Al Juhani showed me in the desert south of AlUla. The war eventually led to the Ottoman Empire’s collapse.

answers_changed.input: The last train on the Hijaz line in what is now Saudi Arabia departed in 1925. By the middle of the past century, it fell into disrepair; even the rails had been removed.
baseline: 在现在的沙特阿拉伯境内，希贾兹铁路的最后一列火车于1925年出发。到上个世纪中叶，它已陷入失修状态，甚至连铁轨都被拆除。
